pack.title: BuzzOff Game Night
pack.description: A full show with a console-gaming streak: PlayStation, famous characters and legendary weapons, alongside China, languages, royals and film twists. Ten board categories, a Video Games category for Final Trivia and five Fast Money surveys. Survey numbers are illustrative, not from a real poll.
pack.author: BuzzOff

categories.title: Made in China
categories.blurb: China: its culture, language and history.

clues.question: Which enormous Chinese structure is often wrongly claimed to be visible from space?
What is the capital of China, home to the Forbidden City?
Which valuable Chinese product, described as "white gold", travelled west along an ancient trading network named after it?
clues.notes: The Silk Road.

clues.question: What is the Chinese name for the characters used to write the Chinese language?
clues.notes: Pronounced roughly "hahn-dzuh". Kanji is the Japanese reading of the same word; host's call.

clues.question: Which dynasty, the last to rule imperial China, fell in 1912?
clues.notes: Said "ching". Its last emperor, Puyi, abdicated as a child.

categories.title: PlayStation Generation
categories.blurb: Three decades of Sony's consoles and the games that sold them.

clues.question: Which four shapes mark the face buttons on a PlayStation controller?
clues.notes: All four are needed, in any order. X is fine for cross.

clues.question: What is the PlayStation 5's controller called, the successor to the DualShock?
Which racing series, billed as "The Real Driving Simulator", has been exclusive to PlayStation since 1997?
Which PlayStation 2 quiz series came with its own set of big red buzzers?
clues.notes: Made in Brighton by Relentless Software. No relation.

clues.question: In which year did the original PlayStation first go on sale, in Japan?
clues.notes: 3 December 1994. It reached Europe in September 1995.

categories.title: AI
categories.blurb: Every answer contains the letters A-I in a row.

clues.question: Which short form of Japanese poetry traditionally follows a five-seven-five syllable pattern?
What do you call a depiction of a person that concentrates on their face and head?
Which compound gives chilli peppers their heat?
Which dark-purple berry is often promoted as a superfood because of its antioxidants?
clues.notes: Pronounced "ah-sah-EE".

clues.question: Which geographical term describes a narrow waterway linking two larger bodies of water?
clues.notes: "Channel" fits the definition but has no A-I.

categories.title: It's a Date
categories.blurb: Holidays and the days they fall on.

clues.question: Which annual celebration of romantic love falls on 14 February?
Which saint's day is celebrated by the Irish, and plenty of others, on 17 March?
On which date do the French celebrate their national day, known abroad as Bastille Day?
On which date do most European countries celebrate Labour Day, or International Workers' Day?
On which date does the European Union mark Europe Day, the anniversary of the Schuman Declaration?
clues.notes: The Schuman Declaration of 9 May 1950 proposed pooling French and German coal and steel.

categories.title: Sorry Not Sorry
categories.blurb: Name the language. Every word here means "sorry".

clues.question: In which language does "désolé" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Say it "day-zo-LAY".

clues.question: In which language does "lo siento" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Say it "lo see-EN-toh".

clues.question: In which language does "Entschuldigung" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Say it "ent-SHOOL-dee-goong".

clues.question: In which language does "gomen nasai" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Say it "go-men nah-sigh".

clues.question: In which language does "przepraszam" mean "sorry"?
clues.notes: Say it "psheh-PRAH-shahm".

categories.title: Player Select
categories.blurb: Name the video game character from the description.

clues.question: Which speedy blue hedgehog is Sega's mascot?
Which yellow arcade character is chased around a maze by ghosts called Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Clyde?
Which British archaeologist and adventurer is the heroine of the "Tomb Raider" series?
Which green-armoured supersoldier, rarely seen without his helmet, is the hero of the "Halo" series?
Which gravel-voiced soldier infiltrates Shadow Moses Island in 1998's "Metal Gear Solid"?
clues.notes: Plain "Snake" is fine.

categories.title: Keeping It in the Family
categories.blurb: Genetics, royal families and people who married their cousins.

clues.question: Which molecule carries the genetic information responsible for inherited characteristics?
Which evolutionary process is commonly summed up by the phrase "survival of the fittest"?
clues.notes: "Evolution" alone is the host's call.

clues.question: Which Habsburg monarch, famous for his severe hereditary health problems, was the dynasty's last king of Spain?
clues.notes: He died without an heir in 1700, which set off the War of the Spanish Succession.

clues.question: Which pioneering naturalist developed the theory of natural selection and married his first cousin?
clues.notes: He married Emma Wedgwood in 1839.

clues.question: Which inherited blood-clotting disorder did Queen Victoria pass on to several of Europe's royal families?
clues.notes: It reached the royal houses of Spain, Germany and Russia through her children and grandchildren.

categories.title: Loadout
categories.blurb: Every answer is a weapon or an item from a famous console game.

clues.question: In "Mario Kart", which spiky item chases down whoever is in first place?
Which legendary blade, also called the Blade of Evil's Bane, rests in a stone pedestal in "The Legend of Zelda" games?
Which concealed, spring-loaded weapon, worn on the forearm, is the trademark of the killers in "Assassin's Creed"?
Which frost-charged axe flies back to its owner's hand when called in 2018's "God of War"?
What is the name of the enormous broadsword carried by Cloud Strife in "Final Fantasy VII"?

categories.title: Spoiler Alert
categories.blurb: Famous twists and endings. Look away now.

clues.question: In "The Empire Strikes Back", who tells Luke Skywalker that he is his father?
In "The Sixth Sense", what does Bruce Willis's character turn out to have been all along?
In "Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince", which teacher kills Albus Dumbledore?
In Agatha Christie's "Murder on the Orient Express", who turns out to have killed the victim?
clues.notes: Twelve of the passengers stab him in turn.

clues.question: In "The Usual Suspects", which character, played by Kevin Spacey, is revealed to be the crime lord Keyser Söze?

categories.title: Famous Balds
categories.blurb: Well-known people without much on top.

clues.question: Which bald billionaire is best known for founding Amazon?
Which former WWE champion turned Hollywood actor is also behind Teremana Tequila?
Which bald musician goes by the nickname "Mr. Worldwide"?
Which bald Frenchman scored twice in the 1998 World Cup final and later coached Real Madrid to three Champions League titles in a row?
Which bald Italian referee, known for his piercing stare, took charge of the 2002 World Cup final?

categories.title: Video Games
categories.blurb: Consoles and the games played on them. Pick it for Final Trivia and the last clue is asked.

clues.question: Which block-building game, all about mining and crafting, is the best-selling video game of all time?
In which battle royale game do players jump into each match from the Battle Bus?
Which football series was renamed "EA Sports FC" in 2023?
clues.notes: "FIFA 23" was the last under the old name.

clues.question: Which Polish studio developed both "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt" and "Cyberpunk 2077"?
Which game, released in 2004, is the best-selling game on the PlayStation 2?
clues.notes: It sold more than 17 million copies on the console. "Grand Theft Auto" alone is not enough.

surveys.question: How many days a week do you shower?
What is a normal price for a cup of coffee, to the nearest euro?
Who is the best character in Mario Party?
Which video game are you best at?
